description: J44 report, Deviations: when the display topology changed under a running game (the 4K primary left the display list, about 16:58 UTC 2026-10-30), the watcher's pending vdisplay_restore.json could no longer apply and refused every launch until it was moved aside by hand. The watcher should detect a restore whose display or position no longer exists, record it, and recover (restore at the new position or drop the stale record) with a host test using a failing fixture. After J18 (watcher guards).
title: Watcher: a virtual display restore whose position is gone
